# Una Meredith

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v5 c5 P110](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0110)</sub>

## Appearance

Una is a thin, sensitive-looking girl with dark, satin-smooth black hair and a sweet, serious face. She is noted for her pale complexion and quiet, mouse-like movements.

_Sources: [v5 c9 P11](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0011), [v5 c33 P36](../source/v05-c33.md#nw-v05-c33-p0036), [v5 c34 P4](../source/v05-c34.md#nw-v05-c34-p0004), [v5 c34 P5](../source/v05-c34.md#nw-v05-c34-p0005), [v5 c34 P12](../source/v05-c34.md#nw-v05-c34-p0012)_

## Personality

Una is deeply sensitive, quiet, and tender-hearted. Exceptionally shy and soft-spoken, she quails at asking favors or facing assertive adults, yet she possesses a profound inner spiritual strength and capacity for self-sacrifice when driven to comfort those she loves. She holds a strong sense of moral responsibility, striving to follow religious guidance to be kind to everyone.

_Sources: [v5 c5 P115](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0115), [v5 c5 P124](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0124), [v5 c9 P10](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0010), [v5 c9 P11](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0011), [v5 c33 P36](../source/v05-c33.md#nw-v05-c33-p0036), [v5 c34 P0](../source/v05-c34.md#nw-v05-c34-p0000), [v5 c34 P4](../source/v05-c34.md#nw-v05-c34-p0004)_

## Traits

- Sensitive  <sub>[v5 c33 P36](../source/v05-c33.md#nw-v05-c33-p0036)</sub>
- Shy and timid  <sub>[v5 c9 P10](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0010)</sub>
- Tender-hearted and empathetic  <sub>[v5 c5 P124](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0124), [v5 c33 P36](../source/v05-c33.md#nw-v05-c33-p0036)</sub>
- Self-sacrificing  <sub>[v5 c34 P0](../source/v05-c34.md#nw-v05-c34-p0000)</sub>
- Fear of stepmothers  <sub>[v5 c34 P0](../source/v05-c34.md#nw-v05-c34-p0000), [v5 c34 P30](../source/v05-c34.md#nw-v05-c34-p0030)</sub>

## Abilities

- Quiet movement  <sub>[v5 c33 P36](../source/v05-c33.md#nw-v05-c33-p0036)</sub>

## Goals

- To comfort and bring happiness to her father  <sub>[v5 c33 P36](../source/v05-c33.md#nw-v05-c33-p0036), [v5 c34 P0](../source/v05-c34.md#nw-v05-c34-p0000), [v5 c34 P3](../source/v05-c34.md#nw-v05-c34-p0003), [v5 c34 P36](../source/v05-c34.md#nw-v05-c34-p0036)</sub>
- To learn domestic skills like cooking and sewing  <sub>[v5 c34 P34](../source/v05-c34.md#nw-v05-c34-p0034)</sub>

## History

Una grows up in the manse at Glen St. Mary as one of minister John Meredith's neglected children. When the runaway waif Mary Vance is discovered hiding, Una takes her in, shares her bed in the attic garret, and comforts her with kindness based on Biblical teachings. Hearing Mary weep over the prospect of returning to an asylum, the shy Una braves her anxiety to visit Miss Cornelia Elliott to ask if she would adopt Mary. When her father suffers deep remorse over his inability to discipline her brother Carl and his broken heart over marital loneliness, Una secretly overhears his agonizing solitude. Motivated by a desperate desire to make him happy, she visits her mother's stored gray silk wedding gown to pray for strength before walking to the house on the hill to plead with Rosemary West to marry her father. Her selfless plea clears up misunderstanding, prompting Rosemary to write a letter accepting the proposal, which Una triumphantly delivers to her father.

_Sources: [v5 c5 P110](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0110), [v5 c5 P115](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0115), [v5 c5 P124](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0124), [v5 c5 P127](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0127), [v5 c9 P7](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0007), [v5 c9 P10](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0010), [v5 c9 P11](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0011), [v5 c33 P36](../source/v05-c33.md#nw-v05-c33-p0036), [v5 c34 P0](../source/v05-c34.md#nw-v05-c34-p0000), [v5 c34 P2](../source/v05-c34.md#nw-v05-c34-p0002), [v5 c34 P3](../source/v05-c34.md#nw-v05-c34-p0003), [v5 c34 P13](../source/v05-c34.md#nw-v05-c34-p0013), [v5 c34 P22](../source/v05-c34.md#nw-v05-c34-p0022), [v5 c34 P24](../source/v05-c34.md#nw-v05-c34-p0024), [v5 c34 P44](../source/v05-c34.md#nw-v05-c34-p0044)_

- Daughter of Rev. John Meredith and his late wife, Cecilia  <sub>[v5 c5 P110](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0110), [v5 c13 P5](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0005), [v5 c34 P2](../source/v05-c34.md#nw-v05-c34-p0002)</sub>
- Grew up motherless in the Glen St. Mary manse with her siblings  <sub>[v5 c33 P36](../source/v05-c33.md#nw-v05-c33-p0036), [v5 c34 P0](../source/v05-c34.md#nw-v05-c34-p0000), [v5 c34 P1](../source/v05-c34.md#nw-v05-c34-p0001)</sub>
